prerequisites: B1/B2 level of the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages.

learning_outcomes.text: Master oral and written communication in comprehension and expression.
Manage information related to scientific and general culture, in academic and professional contexts.
Answer questions based on articles (or other media).
Answer questions based on audio or video files.
Speak in different situations, alone or in interaction.
Write in different contexts, in real-time or not.
Discover current tools and methods and apply them in personal mini-projects.
Create clear and informative images of scientific results and concepts.
Structure a scientific report, know how to write it.
Break down a project into steps to successfully complete it and precisely monitor its progress.
Basic presentation of one's work in front of an audience.
Discovery and mastery of the PEC (Portfolio of Experiences and Skills) tool.
Construction by the student of an orientation strategy and a professional project.
Use reference digital tools and IT security rules to acquire, process, produce and disseminate information, as well as to collaborate internally and externally.
Use different registers of written and oral expression in French with ease.
Identify and situate professional fields potentially related to the acquired knowledge of the mention, as well as possible pathways to access them.
Characterize and valorize one's identity, skills and professional project according to a context.

assessment_methods.method: Continuous assessment for Professional Integration Preparation (POP)

assessment_rules: Assessment for the English, Digital Tools, and Professional Integration Preparation components is based on continuous assessment, each contributing 100% to its respective component's grade. No overall grading formula for the UE or specific resit arrangements are provided.
